contrasts.interpretation: Secondary descriptive version contrast. No isolated stopping-policy causal claim or fresh gate.
contrasts.name: terminal_system_minus_original_system

ci90.tail_definition: two-sided percentile interval from the shared paired draws

lower95.tail_definition: one-sided lower fifth percentile from the same paired draws; do not resample a second time

metric_labels.pooled_slu_micro_f1: slu_f1_micro (pooled official SLU F1 from saved sufficient counts)
metric_labels.row_mean_slu_f1: slu_f1_f1 (mean of per-row official SLU F1)

populations.construction: NEW500 is the existing DEV-1000-NEW500 receipt. OLD500 is the full DEV1000 set difference. DEV1000 is the pooled full receipt. Do not redraw a population or promote a secondary population to primary.

native_system_perception_only.analysis_role: Post-seal system-arm diagnostic only; no roster filtering.
native_system_perception_only.applies_to: System only. The direct arm has no Perception phase or candidate state.
diagnostics: gold intent inclusion in the projected at-most-three system candidate set
system candidate parse, empty, malformed, duplicate, illegal-ID, and saturation outcomes
native_system_perception_only.no_posthoc_filtering: Retain every registered sample in all primary and secondary comparisons regardless of system candidate inclusion or width.

projection.custody: Preserve raw Perception response bytes and hashes unchanged. Bind the separately projected canonical state, every raw position, and projected content hash.
projection.input_contract: Validate every raw compact candidate object from the model-produced one-to-three-candidate system Perception response, then retain the first occurrence of each legal intent_id in original order.
projection.width_semantics: Projected width is the number of distinct model-produced candidates after first-occurrence retention. It is not confidence and is never padded.

analysis_runner.mode: Shared saved-score analysis: completed direct replication, new complete terminal system, and original complete system for a descriptive version comparison. Never score a partial failed arm.

authorization_state: Freeze before new terminal-system generation and before reading the completed direct replication quality. Read only after both comparison arms have verified complete first scores and root binds a separate read release.
binding_state: Direct manifest and original system are source-bound. New system manifest and first-score receipt, and existing direct saved-score receipt wrapper, remain pending; pending values grant no read authority.

diagnostics_after_registered_release.candidate_diagnostic_boundary: System candidate inclusion and width are descriptive diagnostics only. Do not condition, match, exclude, reweight, or redefine the primary NEW500 direct-versus-system comparison with them. The direct arm has no candidate state and no interarm candidate-agreement estimand exists.

cost_and_input_quantities.interpretation: Unequal call count is intentional in this end-to-end system contrast. Quality is primary; model contacts, tool calls, tokens, speech seconds, latency, and supplied knowledge are descriptive costs.
per_arm_required: prompt and completion token totals when available
named knowledge values supplied and consumed

diagnostics_after_registered_release.implementation_boundary: Use shared score_compare_cli and source-bound native diagnostics. Explicit terminal dispositions are reported separately from Planner acceptance.
paired_errors: final system-versus-direct intent, scenario, action, entity, and pooled SLU outcomes on every row
system saves, harms, both-correct, and both-wrong final intent outcomes
refusal, malformed final answer, and output saturation in each arm
diagnostics_after_registered_release.read_rule: Freeze before new terminal-system generation and before reading the completed direct replication quality. Read only after both comparison arms have verified complete first scores and root binds a separate read release.
system_candidate_source: gold intent inclusion in the projected system candidate set
actual projected system width one, two, or three
raw system candidate parse, empty, malformed, duplicate, illegal-ID, and saturation outcomes
system_events: full released candidate-conditioned slot knowledge supplied to joint Solver
optional Planner revision and sole-Solver final-answer custody
OBS, ORG, SUPPLY, and USE event counts when present
Explicit revision-limit terminal delivery count, planner_accepted=false, final Solver source, and task quality of those rows. Descriptive only; retain all rows in primary contrasts.

interpretation.correlation: The arms use the same fixed roster, weights, service geometry, speech features, and task, and are paired by sample. They are separate end-to-end executions; direct does not share or consume a realized system Perception state.
interpretation.inconclusive: The requested interval crosses zero or the guard cannot be evaluated; retain the label and report point estimates, intervals and decomposition.
interpretation.negative: The requested interval is wholly below zero for the named metric; report the component result without a superiority or generalization claim.
interpretation.positive: Exploratory evidence for the revised complete native system versus direct answering on an exposed discovery roster. Not an exact v1 replication, isolated component effect or generalization.

system_effect_flag.condition: Set exploratory_system_candidate=true only when the NEW500 paired speaker-clustered CI90 lower endpoint for slu_f1_micro is greater than zero and the CI90 lower endpoint for scenario_action_exact is greater than or equal to zero.
system_effect_flag.otherwise: Preserve the label negative or inconclusive and report all metric and cost tradeoffs.
system_effect_flag.primary_basis: Pooled micro SLU F1 is primary; intent is the prespecified nonnegative guard.

method_contract.pooled_micro_rule: Compute slu_f1_micro from the declared saved word/character TP, FP and FN fields. Never substitute a mean of row F1 values.
method_contract.primary_estimand: paired speaker-clustered bootstrap delta with 10000 draws and seed 20260913
method_contract.row_mean_rule: Report slu_f1_f1 as the mean of per-row official SLU F1. Never label it pooled micro F1.
secondary_estimands: row-mean SLU F1, reported separately from pooled micro F1
intent, scenario and action exact accuracy
method_contract.sign: system minus direct; higher quality is positive

output.result_read_release: Root binds both verified complete-score receipts and the revised system manifest before a separate read release.
output.source_bindings: Replace pending artifact pins only after complete sealing/scoring; preserve this frozen method recipe as a predecessor.

purpose.candidate_diagnostic_boundary: Candidate inclusion and actual width are system-only diagnostics and never filter the all-row primary comparison.
purpose.claim_boundary: Progressive complete-system evaluation. Keep the failed v1 replication and original positive exploratory result distinct.
purpose.comparison: Pair the already completed direct replication with the newly generated terminal-system recovery on the identical DEV1000 and the same still-resident service process.
purpose.cost_boundary: Unequal call counts are intentional. Quality is primary and cost is descriptive.
purpose.direct_arm: One task-answer contact through the existing direct-only shared controller.
purpose.fixed_execution_context: Both arms use the same frozen weights, resident service np4 with total context 98304 (24576 per slot), max_tokens 256 per request, and prepared speech-feature inputs.
purpose.knowledge_scope: The current system consumes released candidate-conditioned slot knowledge. It consumes no Whisper transcript knowledge or intent-boundary knowledge store.
purpose.primary_question: Can the complete native system with an explicit finite terminal disposition improve task quality versus direct frozen-model answering?
purpose.system_arm: Live Perception candidates, bounded first-occurrence distinct projection, full released candidate-conditioned slot knowledge, joint Solver, Reviewer use of the task-contract native tool, optional Planner revision, and sole-Solver final-answer custody. At the registered revision limit, a further REVISE or ACQUIRE returns the latest eligible Solver response unchanged with an explicit unaccepted terminal disposition.
purpose.tool_claim_boundary: The Reviewer is instructed to use the task-contract native tool. This proves neither selective tool choice nor speech-conditioned tool-use effectiveness.

score_source_contract.no_projection: Use the raw slurp-slu-official result and retain its declared per-row fields plus six pooled count fields. Do not alter estimator semantics.
source_order: Preserve original complete-system sources and the already completed direct replication without invoking a scorer again.
Generate and seal the new entire system roster, then run its complete official scorer once with per-sample fields.
Verify both first complete-score receipts and bind exact manifests in a derived executable analysis configuration.
Record a separate root read release before reading either comparison quality.
Run the shared paired analysis and native diagnostics; include terminal stops in every primary and secondary population.

source_analysis_plan.diagnostic_scope: Report system candidate inclusion and actual width after release. No interarm candidate agreement exists because direct has no Perception state.
source_analysis_plan.pairing: Pair direct and system final task answers by unchanged sample identity over every row. Do not pair, match, or filter by system candidate state.
source_analysis_plan.status: Freeze before either comparison quality read. Preserve the existing direct run; do not repeat it without a named service mismatch.
source_analysis_plan.system_raw_custody: Preserve every raw system Perception response byte and hash. Validate all raw candidate objects before retaining first occurrences of legal intent IDs in original order.

status_clarification.reason: The strict v1 replication aborted at a named bounded-episode component. This prospective one-recovery version changes only the explicit terminal delivery policy and associated receipt semantics. It is not an exact v1 replication.
